headline: Three characterized hypotheses; a new analogue discovery is not established
conclusion: The six-region experiment measured 8,507 valid windows and froze 36 comparisons. 4 comparisons met the visible-landform rubric in a model-assisted assessment. The deeper literature search found prior analogue work around the promising settings, so this release reports new source-linked characterizations and preserves unresolved novelty instead of asserting a new discovery.

leads.statement: A source-linked regional mapping hypothesis centered at 34.51237, -115.54262. The observed floor/margin arrangement passes the frozen model-assisted image rubric. Prior analogue work prevents a new-region claim; exact task/footprint novelty remains unresolved.

gates.name: Independent review

limitations: Irrigated circular fields and roads modify the modern Earth floor; the terrain DEM and image dates differ. The Earth basin is not an impact crater counterpart or a mineral match.
Model-assisted remote characterization; no independent expert or field validation. A bounded search cannot prove absence of prior work.
